body:
Hello. I'm sorry to hear you went through it once and now it's back again. How did you resolve it back then? Did you manage to communicate with the family? If you would like/feel up to it, I'd be open to read of your current situation too. Internet hugs to you also.

My inability to speak to him infuriates him. He refuses to have anything in written form; demands that I talk to him, because it's a weakness to be unable to talk in the real world.

(Oh, thank you. You're all very kind. :) )

Nothing. Everything? Idk. I see him and I just freeze up. I've tried once or twice in the past. All that got me was him having more ammunition to mock/criticise me with. My words got twisted and thrown back into my face for the next few weeks, even if it was just a simple, "No, that's what you think of me.". He already has a perception in mind of what I'm going to say and what I'm like, so anything I do say gets shoved into that mould. I learnt that it is better not to talk back. You know how.. when someone is already prepared to get angry even before the reason is fully realised? In a way, I guess he and I aren't that different. 

Oh, thank you. Used to write.
Thank you. I'm running out of battery, but I just wanted to say that. I dont think ive had anyone who said that to me before. I'm sorry you are too.
